technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions across multiple RSI/Stoch indicators conflict with bullish technicals; golden cross and volume spike show strength but lack confirmation, making this a high-risk entry with limited margin of safety.

fundamental.summary: AME shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 91 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from junior member with modest sales; broad market neutral sentiment offers no contrarian edge; insufficient data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve signalling recession risk and VIX at crisis levels (346.4) creates highly unfavourable trading environment despite distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 20/50), 20-day donchian new high, and 15x volume spike suggest early-stage momentum breakout with technical confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 89.73, Stoch 87.23), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, zero fundamental support, and price below VWAP create a high-probability mean reversion setup with severe macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and 15x volume spike suggest early momentum, but entry is negated by extreme overbought conditions (RSI 89.73, Stoch 87.23) and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis).
decision.primary_risk: Mean reversion from overbought extremes in a recessionary macro environment with inverted yield curve and VIX at crisis levels will likely trigger sharp pullback before any upside materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias
decision.portfolio_note: Already 26 positions in Industrials sector; adding AME increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without fundamental or institutional support.
